title: (How did you/How are you) choosing your Universities? - 5 Minutes
description:
Hello! I'm an A-Level student building a University Research Service.
I'm trying to learn how people actually choose their universities, 12 Questions, 5 Minutes. 
Thanks a lot for participating in this survey😁🥰

items.title: How far along are you in choosing?
options: I know the country, don't know the universities yet
I have a few universities in mind
I know exactly what universities I want to apply

items.title: Do you know the person who sent you this form?
options: No, it was forwarded to me

items.title: So far, roughly how many hours have you spent researching universities and courses?
Which of these have you actually used?
options: Social media channels (Youtube, Instagram, Tiktok, Rednote, etc)

items.title: Has your family paid anyone to help with chooing or applying to university?
Which ONE of these worries you the most?
options: Knowing the real total cost of attending the university
Future job prospects (Whether degree obtained is recognised in Malaysia)

items.title: For the University you most serious about, which of these have you actually looked up? Tick any that apply
options: How much money the visa needs you to show in bank
Whether I can stay and work there after graduating
Whether the Degree is recognised in Malaysia
What jobs graduates of that course actually get

items.title:
Think of last time you got stuck researching universities, what was it, and what did you do? 
(Short text, optional)
I have 2 services, which would you prefer?
options: RM50 : Personalised University List: 20 to 30 universities of your desired country & course. Ranked according to how well they fit you. Includes Total cost of Attendance, Scholarships Avalilable, Whether its a Reach/Match/Safety and much more.:
RM30 : A deep report on ONE university you name: the full cost in ringgit, scholarships, work rules, whether the degree is recognised in Malaysia, and what students there say about it.

items.title: A sample of the list of universities, but with your desired countries and courses
A sneakpeak of the university report, 15 sections, this is just 1 shown.

Leave your WhatsApp number if you WANT the above, slots open November, I will message you personally.

If not, stating your reason would be helpful.😁🥰
